title: Standards.
officialText: Gypsum board materials shall conform to the appropriate standards listed in Table 2506.2 and Chapter 35 and, where required for fire protection, shall conform to the provisions of Chapter 7. GYPSUM BOARD MATERIALS AND ACCESSORIES
